brainlife.desc: PET image (static or dynamic NIfTI) with BIDS JSON sidecar and optional blood sampling data (TSV + JSON).
brainlife.name: neuro/pet

file_descs.blood_json: JSON file describing the columns contained in a blood.tsv file.
file_descs.blood_tsv: TSV file containing manual or automatically sampled PET blood data limited to: time, plasma_radioactivity, metabolite_parent_fraction, whole_blood_radioactivity,  metabolite_parent_fraction,  hplc_recover_fractions.
file_descs.pet_json: JSON sidecar file containing PET radiochemistry, pharmaceutical, time, reconstruction, hardware, institution, tissue, de-identification, and task data.
file_descs.pet_nii: NifTI file containing dynamic or static PET imaging data

original.readme: This datatype is written to support PET data conforming (but not limited to) the Brain Imaging Data Structure. For more information about neuro/pet first browse [the PET BIDS spec](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/positron-emission-tomography.html).

brainlife.readme:
This datatype is written to support PET data conforming (but not limited to) the Brain Imaging Data Structure. For more information about neuro/pet first browse [the PET BIDS spec](https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/stable/modality-specific-files/positron-emission-tomography.html).

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.pet.json
